# Clinical Assessment

This folder covers the practical challenges and methodologies involved in the initial clinical evaluation of patients, particularly in acute and surgical settings. It documents specific regional findings on the limitations of comorbidity metrics, such as the Charlson Score misclassifying elderly patients, and outlines the primary diagnostic hurdles in identifying conditions like acute abdomen when patients present with atypical symptoms or secondary complications.

## Pages

- [[clinical-assessment|Clinical Assessment]] — Outlines regional observations on the inaccuracies of the Charlson Score for older populations and the three main diagnostic challenges in assessing possible acute abdomen.
